Derive equilibrium initial state proportions

Source: R/sim_diags_fns.R
derive_init_props.Rd

Computes quasi-steady-state latent compartment proportions by solving the linear no-aging system (I - Q) lat = h, where Q is the single-age-group transition matrix built from the supplied diagnosis probabilities and progression rates. The result gives good starting values for init_props or init_props_abroad when the undiagnosed stock is assumed to be near equilibrium before the simulation window.

Usage

derive_init_props(
  d_probs_t1 = c(0.055, 0.065, 0.13, 0.35),
  q = c(0.0976, 0.115, 0.116, 0.148),
  mu_lat_t1 = NULL,
  abroad = FALSE,
  scale = if (!abroad) 7 else NULL,
  rita = FALSE
)

Arguments

d_probs_t1

Numeric vector of diagnosis probabilities at t = 1. Length 4 for CD4-only (rita = FALSE); length 5 for RITA (rita = TRUE): element 1 is the RITA (recent-infection) diagnosis probability, elements 2–5 are the CD4-stratified probabilities.

q

Numeric vector of length 4: quarterly CD4 progression probabilities, matching the default q = c(0.0976, 0.115, 0.116, 0.148).

mu_lat_t1

Numeric vector of relative inflow weights across latent states at t = 1. Required when abroad = TRUE. For RITA, the first three elements should be 0 (migrants enter long-standing states only). Will be normalised internally to sum to 1.

abroad

Logical. FALSE (default): solve for the native group with all inflow entering state 1. TRUE: solve for the migrant stock with inflow distributed via mu_lat_t1.

scale

Numeric or NULL. When non-NULL, the output is scaled so that its first non-zero element equals scale. Defaults to 7 for the native group so the result is on the same scale as the built-in init_props default. Defaults to NULL for the migrant group: the unscaled solve already gives values in the correct units for direct use as init_props_abroad (latent stock per unit of quarterly migration into latent states).

rita

Logical. Use the RITA compartment structure (7 latent states).

Value

Numeric vector of length nlatst (4 for CD4-only, 7 for RITA).

Details

The function mirrors the compartment logic in Q_mat: for the native group (abroad = FALSE) all inflow enters state 1; for the migrant stock (abroad = TRUE) inflow is distributed across latent states proportionally to mu_lat_t1.
